Unified CLI & Core Management

Unified openre CLI supporting project creation, scan orchestration, findings management, AI operations, plugin handling, and report generation.

Concurrent job/workflow engine featuring background job management, cancellation, retry handling, status tracking, and parallel workers.

Cross-domain correlation linking software-development artifacts, binaries, dependencies, and security findings.

Interactive Terminal UI (TUI)

Full-screen interactive TUI with views for projects, jobs, scans, reverse engineering, findings, workflows, AI agents, plugins, logs, and reports.

Live metric tracking for task progress, subprocess status, agent states, resource usage, and workflow dependencies.

Reverse Engineering & Binary Analysis

Multi-format binary support covering ELF, PE, Mach-O, and WASM parsing.

Program analysis capabilities including identification, loading, disassembly, control-flow and data-flow tracking, type recovery, and decompilation.

Security Scanning & Profiles

Configurable scan profiles including Quick (6 checks), Standard (15 checks), and Full (18+ checks).

Automated security regression hunting, patch correctness verification, and automatic exploitability validation.

AI Security Analyst & Automation

Multi-provider LLM support integrating Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, ONNX Runtime, and llama.cpp.

Autonomous agentic execution for artifact inspection, tool selection, analysis correlation, and patch generation.

Built-in context management, PII filtering, and confidence scoring.

Plugin Ecosystem

WASM runtime sandboxing and capability-based security.

Plugin registry supporting installation, runtime controls, security extensions, Fuel metering, memory limits, and syscall filtering.

Web API & Frontend Platform

REST API, gRPC, and WebSocket infrastructure secured via JWT, API keys, rate limiting, and versioning.

React and Tailwind CSS frontend delivering a responsive dashboard, finding browser, AI chat, and settings manager.

Docker Compose configuration for multi-service deployment (API, worker, and frontend).

Multi-platform release distribution targeted at Linux, macOS, and Windows across x86_64 and ARM64 architectures.
